title: Manual code reviews on pull-request projects
text: Projects that send approved work out as a pull request can have each card's work code reviewed too. With code reviews set to "Manually, at handover", a purple "Start code review" button appears next to "Approve (PR)" when the agent hands over. A click starts the review before the pull request opens, and while it runs, approving warns that the review is still going.
chapters: A project that lands through pull requests
